sql: SELECT s.School, f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, (f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS `FRPM Rate (K-12)` FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.SOC = 66 ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 5
raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    s.School, 
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)`, 
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 
    (f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS `FRPM Rate (K-12)`
FROM 
    frpm f
JOIN 
    schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE 
    s.SOC = 66
ORDER BY 
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.nationality = 'Japanese' AND T2.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.driverId) AS race_completion_percentage FROM drivers AS T1 JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId JOIN races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId WHERE T3.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
raw:
```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.nationality = 'Japanese' AND T2.time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.driverId) AS race_completion_percentage
FROM 
    drivers AS T1
JOIN 
    results AS T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId
JOIN 
    races AS T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId
WHERE 
    T3.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;
```

sql: SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS List FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0 GROUP BY Patient.SEX
raw:
```sql

  Patient.SEX,
```
